facts.fact: Eden 带进镇的第一人：连 Gemma 都没来过这个 sleepy little place——Oliver 是头一个外人。
facts.anchor: This is the first time I’ve brought someone not from the town here. Not even Gemma has made the trek out to this sleepy little place.

facts.fact: 山顶烟花夜第三吻：慢、轻、郑重——「这不是偷来的时刻，我们有的是时间」。
facts.anchor: This isn’t a stolen moment. We have all the time in the world.

facts.fact: 山顶告白：「I do like you, Eden」——他愿意按她的任何条件接受她。
facts.anchor: I know you want to focus on school, but I’m happy to have you any way I can.

facts.fact: Eden 的情感幽闭恐惧：谈感受让她 claustrophobic——接吻永远比说话容易。
facts.anchor: Why is kissing so much easier than talking?

facts.fact: 学期过半的暗恐惧：过半之后就没有每周见他的借口了。
facts.anchor: Halfway through until I don’t have an excuse to see Oliver every week.

facts.fact: 回程车内交底：「不是关于吻…也关于吻。但我不后悔」——只是「从没做过这事」。
他的宣言：「I want to try with you, Eden. I've never felt this way about anyone.」
facts.anchor: I want to try with you, Eden.

facts.fact: 她主动喊出「I'm coming in」——要跟他进家门见他的家人，他被吓了一跳。
facts.anchor: You want to come, with me, into my house, and meet my family?

facts.fact: Oliver 父亲的毒句：这就是你私奔带的姑娘——连正眼都没给她一个。
facts.anchor: So, this is the girl you ran away with.

facts.fact: 她的遗传观察：父子同眉同鼻，但 Dad 的薄唇只会讥讽，Oliver 的唇天生为笑而生。
facts.anchor: while his dad’s thin lips curl into a sneer, Oliver’s are different, like they’re made for smiling.

facts.fact: 额头吻收尾——「我们没事。暂时」。
